title: Engagement Input Space Typing
description: Engagement input does not allow spaces; space acts like enter. Fix command input to preserve spaces in engagement mode.
summary: Fixed engagement command input treating Space like Enter. Engagement mode now preserves spaces in onChange (`replNormalizeCommandText`), routes Space into the draft instead of REPL submit/complete handlers, and keeps aside REPL space-stripping behavior unchanged. Added unit tests in CAD renderer and UI Engagement.
